source: Owner's request 23.11.2026 (ChatGPT recommendation, reviewed by Claude): gold and the S&P 500 on Bybit Demo. Pre-registered: parameters fixed from the literature before any TradFi result was looked at.
title: Trend Following (TSMOM 30d) – gold & S&P 500

preregistration.hypothesis: TF1a: gold and the S&P 500 trend at the monthly horizon (time-series momentum, Moskowitz/Ooi/Pedersen 2012; Hurst/Ooi/Pedersen 2017 – a century of evidence in commodities and equity indices).
preregistration.why_these_parameters: Exactly the system's pre-registered crypto benchmark (benchmark-tsmom-4h-30d): 30-day return in 30-day volatility units on 4h candles, entry at ±0.5, exit when momentum turns, 4×ATR catastrophic stop, no take profit. Same rule in a new asset class – nothing chosen for gold or the S&P 500.
preregistration.decision_rule: Forward book from the first registration (hypothesis TF1, shadow only). Judged against buy & hold of the same instrument over the same days, not against BTC. No verdict before 180 forward days; with 2 instruments and multi-week holds expect ~10–25 trades a year: years, not weeks, for a statistical answer.
preregistration.stop_rule: Stop if forward drawdown exceeds 3× the backtest's 95th percentile or the instruments are delisted; record it, never tune it.

provenance.clean_evidence: Only the forward test from the freeze. Bybit's TradFi perpetuals have too little history (gold since spring 2026, SPY since May 2026) for the system's walk-forward (≥ 120-day warm-up + training + ≥ 4 test quarters); a replication on them can reject, never validate.
